reponse:
Yes—both were picked up. The webhook fix is verified in sandbox; per-seller payout schedules won’t make the December 7 launch [3][5][14].

1. **Webhook signatures were failing in sandbox.** Jake Whitfield took it on and deployed the fix to sandbox on Nov 16. Ellen turned verification back on and confirmed that 300+ events passed on Nov 17. Production rollout is scheduled for Nov 24 [1][5][14].
2. **Tradewell needs two payout schedules:** net-7 for about 200 top sellers and net-30 for everyone else. Owen Park took it to Product and Engineering, Sofia Alvarez filed QPAY-2362, and Avi Kessler moved it to the Q1 backlog, with late January the earliest. Owen promised Martin an answer by Nov 20; Martin chased on Nov 17, and I don’t see a reply yet [1][3][5].
